name: nakabandi
description: NAKABANDI monorepo root. Scripts are the one command per task on every OS (DOC 2 §2.2).

scripts.test: uv run pytest && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.ci: npm run ci:py && npm run ci:web && npm run ci:bank-sim
scripts.ci:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright && uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest
scripts.ci:web: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.ci:bank-sim: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/bank-sim && npm run test --workspace apps/bank-sim
scripts.types: uv run python scripts/gen_contract_schemas.py && git diff --stat --exit-code packages/contracts/src/nakabandi_contracts/schemas
